purpose: One consolidated source tree; select only requested A/B experiments. Selection never flips production defaults.

retained_binaries.reuse_rule: Retain original source and hashes. Reuse only when relevant numerical sources, flags, architecture and compiler match; never relabel a006 binaries as built from the consolidated commit.

launch_policy: Only selected candidates plus necessary baseline. Do not repeat completed experiments or run diagnostic-only candidates. Existing owned boxes; no duplicate controllers.
